## Design

### 2026-10-13 – I spent quite a while getting dimensions and designing what I wanted to build actually. I realised that it would be difficult to get a fully transparent 3D printed enclosure, so I will use a laser cut

**2h**

I spent quite a while getting dimensions and designing what I wanted to build actually. I realised that it would be difficult to get a fully transparent 3D printed enclosure, so I will use a laser cutter to cut out plastic acrylic and connected by 3D designed parts that will hold each place and part together.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pYiuxHwsnPP3tNULfelu922LcuxvhBQz/0b5a1de1836fbf7df8c2146111e52ef3540c06e279cbaf0da8a3293c29651fc1.png)
The dimensions are 102.5 x 83 mm.

On top of that. I am probably going to 3D design keycaps.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pYiuxHwsnPP3tNULfelu922LcuxvhBQz/ddac165726aeb0e7c9f055514a50dae888f7932d9e171393003012037638a8f5.png)

### 2026-10-15 – Finally something I'm good at. I quite a pro when it comes to 3D designing. ;)

**4h**

Finally something I'm good at. I quite a pro when it comes to 3D designing. ;)
I was pretty productive and designed the screen cover for the macro pad so that it fits in between the switches and PCB (kinda). And I also designed the top of the cases.

But then I realised how silly and stupid I was... I can't actually fully be certain of the dimensions without seeing my project and PCB in real life! But I will continue designing and print it regardless. I will do 2 designs, one using plastic acrylic lazercutted and one 3D printed

### 2026-10-17 – Broo...it's kinda hard to work on stuff like this this with a broken hand :D. If you haven't guessed it yet - I broke my hand it's in cast so it's kinda hard to type and work use my computer in genera

**7h**

Broo...it's kinda hard to work on stuff like this this with a broken hand :D. If you haven't guessed it yet - I broke my hand it's in cast so it's kinda hard to type and work use my computer in general. So it took a lot longer the usual. However, I need finish 1 of the designs. As the minimum number of PCBs I have to order is 5, I might make a couple different designs.

I've just finished the 3D solid colour and opaque CAD design which took longer than expected. I've disregarded my previous designs as the dimensions are all of the place there is a large chance it won't fit. So I redesigned it as there sin't much of a difference at that point.

I've realised that I though I was a pro, but there is still so much more stuff I need to work on.

I've almost also finished my acrylic case which is more simplier than the CAD that I plan to finish tomorrow.
